description: Simulates a restriction digest with a CALLER-SUPPLIED enzyme definition and yields the resulting fragments, each with its sequence, start, length, flanking enzymes and the blunt/5'/3' overhang of each cut end. The enzyme is given exactly as in find_sites_custom_enzyme (recognition sequence plus the two cut offsets, optionally a second pair for a two-sided Type IIB cutter). Fragment conventions, the circular k-fragments-for-k-cuts rule and the methylation mode are exactly as in restriction_digest. Call when the enzyme is not one of the 754 named REBASE enzymes — for a named one use restriction_digest.

sequence.description: DNA sequence to digest. IUPAC ambiguity codes are accepted anywhere in the sequence.

recognition_sequence.description: Recognition sequence of the custom enzyme: 1 or more of the 15 IUPAC nucleotide codes; need not be palindromic.

cut_position_forward.description: Top-strand cut offset: the number of recognition-sequence bases 5' of the cut. May be negative or exceed the site length for a distal cutter.

cut_position_reverse.description: Bottom-strand cut offset in the same frame.

name.description: Name reported on each fragment's flanking-enzyme fields; defaults to "CustomEnzyme".

topology.description: Linear (default) or Circular: whether the molecule is a linear fragment or a closed circle (plasmid).

second_cut_forward.description: Optional second top-strand cut offset of a two-sided (Type IIB) cutter; pass both second offsets or neither.

second_cut_reverse.description: Optional second bottom-strand cut offset; must leave the same stagger as the first pair.

methylation.description: Optional methylation-aware recognition (EMBOSS restrict -methylation semantics): "none" (default), "dam", "dcm", "dam+dcm" or "emboss".

fragments.description: Fragments in the same shape as restriction_digest.

errors.message: Pass both second_cut_forward and second_cut_reverse, or neither.
Enzyme '<name>' recognition sequence '<site>' contains '<char>' at index <i>, which is not one of the 15 IUPAC nucleotide codes
Enzyme '<name>' second cut pair (<f>, <r>) leaves a different stagger from its first pair

output.fragments: 2 fragments of 4 and 8 nt, the same partition restriction_digest gives for EcoRI
1 fragment of 12 — one cut on a circle leaves the molecule linearised, not split

examples.name: Half a second cut pair is an error

error.message: Pass both second_cut_forward and second_cut_reverse, or neither.
